description: Relocate DAD-specific code into src/targets/dad/ (index.js/config.js/compose.js/sql.js) with DadAdapter extending the FEAT-001 ProvisioningAdapter, relocate the benchmark adapter to src/targets/benchmark.js, move the registry to src/targets/index.js, repoint the registry importers, and install thin re-export shims at the three old paths so every existing deep import and src/runner.js stay unchanged. Then add the full byte-identical guard set: policy digest+JSON snapshot, compose/exec argv snapshots for EVERY rewritten call site (including suite per fold-in #1), and the two-adapter interface-conformance test. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (ProvisioningAdapter must exist). Grounded in src/dad.js, src/targets.js, src/benchmark-adapter.js, src/discovery-runner.js read in full.

Keep verbatim in dad/index.js: the exploration-vs-acceptance mode branching and BOTH summary-string variants in build()/database(); the *-checks image-build block (fold-in #4: it is at src/dad.js label `build-${service}-checks` ~line 266-272, NOT 264-272 — rely on the label as locator); the §2 validation-only methods (invitation, verifyStaff, donorFixture, verifyDonor, performanceFixture, suite, discoveryState, sql-now-via-execSql); deploy()'s readiness health-exec `this.compose(['exec','-T','web','node','-e',...])` as plain compose (fold-in #2, pure relocation); discoveryReplayFixture()'s stop/start/pg_dump as plain compose (fold-in #2). Re-export composeDefinition from dad/index.js for the shim.
Create src/targets/benchmark.js: move src/benchmark-adapter.js verbatim (BenchmarkAdapter does NOT extend ProvisioningAdapter). Update internal import depths (../core.js, ../discovery-benchmark.js).
Create src/targets/index.js: move the registry (targets, resolveTarget, isRegisteredAdapter) from src/targets.js unchanged in value, importing './dad/index.js' and './benchmark.js'.

Repoint registry importers from './targets.js' to './targets/index.js' in src/discovery-runner.js (line 11), src/cli.js (line ~10), src/policy.js (line 6). Mechanical, zero behavioral change. LEAVE src/runner.js UNCHANGED.

Replace the three old files with thin shims: src/targets.js -> `export * from './targets/index.js';`; src/dad.js -> `export { DadAdapter } from './targets/dad/index.js';` + `export { composeDefinition } from './targets/dad/compose.js';`; src/benchmark-adapter.js -> `export * from './targets/benchmark.js';`. Enforce: no file under src/targets/ imports a shim (../targets.js, ../dad.js, ../benchmark-adapter.js) — import real modules directly (keeps the graph an acyclic DAG).

Extend test/targets.test.js with the policy digest+JSON snapshot (fold-in / invariant): assert discoveryPolicy('dad').digest === 'be91648ac06f7508faf9148c339d25e0a704f4b7c61c7918b8e7b23892113954'; assert JSON.stringify(discoveryPolicy('dad').definition) === the pinned 869-char body from design §8.6(a); keep the existing relative `=== discoveryPolicy().digest` check.

Add the compose/exec argv-snapshot guard (new test/dad-argv.test.js or extend adapter.test.js): drive a DadAdapter with a stubbed command (lowest point both logged->command and compose->command pass through; no Docker) and assert the emitted argv equals the pinned pre-refactor literal for EACH of: database-start, migrations, test-migrations (acceptance mode), suite('api-tests') => ['compose','-p',<id>,'-f',<file>,'run','--rm','-T','api-tests'], suite('web-tests') => [...,'web-tests'] (fold-in #1), deploy, cleanup down, and the sql/exec path: sql('SELECT 1') => ['compose','-p',<id>,'-f',<file>,'exec','-T','postgres','psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U','atm_owner','-d','dad_atm','-At']. deploy's readiness health-exec and replay stop/start/pg_dump are NOT separately guarded (fold-in #2 — covered transitively by the sql/exec guard).

Add an interface-surface conformance test (fold-in / design §6): for both resolveTarget('dad').adapterFactory(...) and BenchmarkAdapter assert the required methods snapshot/docker/build/database/deploy/discoveryFixture/cleanup are present, publicOrigin/signal are assignable, and discoveryReplayFixture/source are absent-or-right-kind.

Run `npm run lint` and `npm test` (unchanged test imports must all resolve via shims). Run `git -C /Users/shawncoe/Documents/dev/DAD/atm/.worktrees/move3-adapter-split diff dev -- src/runner.js` and confirm EMPTY output. Fix anything red. Commit locally on feat/adapter-interface; never push. Record in findings: confirmation that runner.js diff is empty and all argv/policy guards pass.
